headline: Sekisui Chemical Delivers Record H1 FY2026 Profit Driven by Pricing Power
summary: Japan's Sekisui Chemical posted record first-half fiscal 2026 operating profits, supported by firm pricing discipline across its high-performance plastics and housing materials divisions.
why: Sekisui Chemical is a major Japanese manufacturer of industrial plastics, urban infrastructure piping, and prefabricated housing systems with extensive international reach.

impacts.why: Record profit driven by effective price management across core divisions.
